done_when: A change to review code runs the split and review-noise tests in its related-test check, a split's decisions survive a later review, and the missing-tool review-choice skip test passes.
why: A change to review code can pass its own related-test check while the split and review-noise tests fail, which turned main red twice on 16 Nov 2026; a split's decisions may also be lost when a later review runs, and one review-choice skip test fails before these changes.
